[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommends the following Mindful Movement practices for beginners:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Yoga: Combines movement with meditation, deep breathing, and relaxation techniques; reduces stress, increases flexibility, and improves strength.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Tai Chi: Involves slow, graceful movements; improves balance, flexibility, and mental focus; low-impact.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Pilates: Focuses on core strength, posture, and flexibility; low-impact; reduces stress and increases body awareness.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Walking Meditation: Involves walking slowly and mindfully while focusing on breath and body sensations; reduces stress and increases mindfulness.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Stretching: Simple exercises like hamstring stretches, quadriceps stretches, neck stretches, and shoulder rolls; boosts flexibility and reduces muscle tension.
